caption: A person in a dark shirt stands at a speckled granite counter, one hand resting on a white sheet of paper while the other reaches toward a pink spiky ball just above it. The active hand closes around the ball at the paper surface, then lifts it upward off the sheet. The ball is pinched in the air above the paper while the resting hand keeps the sheet in place. The reaching arm extends forward and upward as it holds the ball, and a foreground camera shows a pink blur on its screen. Later, the active hand opens and releases the ball. It drops toward the paper, blurs downward, and then rebounds upward above the sheet. The closed doors, wall switch, and countertop items remain fixed.
